Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full flight-status card payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Flight AF128","status":"in_air","origin":{"code":"SFO","city":"San Francisco","time":"10:35 AM","gate":"A12","terminal":"2"},"dest":{"code":"JFK","city":"New York","time":"7:05 PM","terminal":"4","baggage":"Belt 6"},"progressPct":62,"aircraft":"Airbus A321neo","durationText":"5h 30m","updatedText":"Live · updated just now","submitText":"Get gate updates","submitValue":"Send me gate and delay updates for flight AF128"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): the card heading, usually the flight number, e.g. 'Flight AF128'. Defaults to 'Flight status'.
- 'status' (string, recommended): the live flight state. Use ONE of exactly: 'scheduled', 'boarding', 'departed', 'in_air', 'landed', 'delayed', 'cancelled'. Drives the coloured status pill and the plane's position.
- 'statusLabel' (string, optional): a display override for the pill text; if omitted a sensible label is derived from 'status' (e.g. 'in_air' shows 'In air').
- 'origin' (object, recommended): the departure airport — { 'code' (string, e.g. 'SFO'), 'city' (string, optional), 'time' (string, optional, e.g. '10:35 AM'), 'gate' (string, optional), 'terminal' (string, optional) }.
- 'dest' (object, recommended): the arrival airport — same shape as 'origin' plus 'baggage' (string, optional, the baggage-claim belt, e.g. 'Belt 6'). Note: 'baggage' applies to the destination only.
- 'progressPct' (number, optional): 0-100, the plane's position along the route arc. Ignored when status is 'scheduled' or 'boarding' (forced to 0) or 'landed' (forced to 100).
- 'aircraft' (string, optional): aircraft type, e.g. 'Airbus A321neo'; shown under the title.
- 'durationText' (string, optional): flight duration, e.g. '5h 30m'; appended after the aircraft as '<aircraft> · <durationText>'.
- 'updatedText' (string, optional): a freshness caption, e.g. 'Live · updated just now'.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): the get-updates button label; defaults to 'Get updates'.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): the EXACT message sent back to the agent when the button is tapped; defaults to a sensible 'Send me gate and delay updates...' phrase.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads. Only include fields you actually have; omit unknown ones rather than inventing values.
